units.source_text: 这个年轻人正是富家公子杜子春，

en.t: This young man was none other than Toshishun, the son of a wealthy family,

units.source_text: 现在他已经倾家荡产，朝不保夕，

en.t: but now he had squandered his entire fortune and could barely get through each day,

units.source_text: 今后的日子如何走下去难以想象。

en.t: and it was impossible to imagine how he would go on living from then on.
